targets.summary: The GemmEpilogueIRCodegen class (and related codegen helpers) may belong in gemm_epilogue_ir rather than a separate gemm_epilogue_codegen module.
targets.evidence: Before the change, line 102 read `class GemmEpilogueIRCodegen:` ("Lower scheduler loop-body expressions to a CuTeDSL fragment function."). The merged diff deletes the whole class from gemm_epilogue_codegen.py: `__init__`, `load`, `args_kwargs`, `lower`, `render` and `from_buffers` are all gone. The imports the class needed from `.gemm_epilogue_ir` (`GemmEpilogueIRAnalysis`, `GemmEpilogueIRExpression`) are removed too, along with `V`, `ComputedBuffer` and `OrderedSet`. The module docstring changes from "Shared CuTeDSL expression emission" to "Shared CuTeDSL emission primitives", so the file now holds only the op overrides, the body/kernel helpers and a new `gemm_epilogue_op_scope`. The class no longer lives in the codegen module, which matches the request to move it into gemm_epilogue_ir. I couldn't see the gemm_epilogue_ir diff, so I can't confirm the class appears there, but the removed IR imports point that way.
